checkpoint_summary_definitions.title: Backlinks
checkpoint_summary_definitions.info: Backlinks to a site are very important as search engines use these as a 'vote' making it appear higher in the search rankings. The volume of backlinks is also a good measure as to how popular a site is. A backlink ratio is the number of backlinks compared to the number of linking websites. A low ratio can indicate a lack of diversity in the backlinks.
checkpoint_summary_definitions.good_definition: more than 40 backlinks and a unique domain ratio between 5:1 and 10:1
checkpoint_summary_definitions.warning_definition: at least 5 but less than 40 backlinks, or a ratio below 5:1 or above 10:1
checkpoint_summary_definitions.bad_definition: less than 5 backlinks
